shots.focal_element: Strained character's face (sweat drop, squeezed eyes) under a huge white orb held overhead
shots.typography: Corner wordmark only: lowercase bold geometric sans with a short underscore-style bar before it, tight tracking; persistent top-right bug
shots.what_happens: Close top-down view of the character lifting a large white orb above its head; between the 10.0 s and 10.5 s frames the head and arms shift slightly as if straining, a sweat drop on the forehead sells the effort. No speech in this shot (words resume at w15).
shots.build_rebuild: Layer flat vector shapes (orange torso, tan head and hands, white orb circle with thin dark outline) on a flat teal background and animate a small up-down strain loop on the arms and head with a sweat-drop sprite, keeping the logo bug fixed top-right.

shots.focal_element: White orb pressed onto the character's head with a lime highlight appearing at its top
shots.typography: Corner wordmark only: lowercase bold geometric sans, same top-right bug
shots.what_happens: Three-frame (about 0.125 s) cut to a tighter angle: the orb now sits over the character's face, hands gripping its sides, and lime highlight shapes begin to appear on the orb's upper right, reading as the orb lighting up.
shots.build_rebuild: Insert a 3-frame cut where the orb is scaled up and moved down over the head, and pop in two lime highlight shapes (a capsule and a dot) at the orb's upper right.

shots.focal_element: White orb with a lime gloss highlight, held up from the bottom of frame
shots.typography: Corner wordmark only: lowercase bold geometric sans, same top-right bug
shots.what_happens: Camera pulls back: the orb, now with a clear lime capsule-and-dot gloss highlight, sits centred and is held up by hands at the bottom edge on an empty teal field. The voice-over says the brand name here (w15 'Zapier'), and an anchor event plus an impact-labelled SFX (x006) land in this shot.
shots.build_rebuild: Hard-cut to a wider framing with the white outlined orb centred, a lime capsule-plus-dot highlight on its upper right and the hands cropped at the bottom edge, timing the cut so the brand-name word and the impact hit fall inside it.

shots.focal_element: Low-angle character: small orb overhead, large flared orange cape and lime legs
shots.typography: Corner wordmark only: lowercase bold geometric sans, same top-right bug
shots.what_happens: Three-frame cut to an extreme low angle (worm's-eye) of the character holding the orb high above its head; the orange and navy cape billows outward and lime legs fill the bottom of frame, still on the plain teal background.
shots.build_rebuild: Draw the character in exaggerated forced perspective (tiny head and orb at top, huge cape and legs at the bottom) on the teal field and hold it for 3 frames as a beat before the background switch.

shots.focal_element: Triumphant low-angle character raising the orb, with a burst of zigzag rays radiating from it
shots.typography: Corner wordmark only: lowercase bold geometric sans, same top-right bug
shots.what_happens: Same low angle, but the teal background is replaced by a radiating starburst of jagged lavender and cream zigzag bands spreading out from the orb, with scattered circular plus-sign badges (pink, orange, lime) and small dots; the character's mouth is open in triumph and the boots now show white stripes.
shots.build_rebuild: Swap the background on a hard cut to a radial burst of jagged lavender and cream polygons centred on the orb, and scatter flat circles with thin plus glyphs around the frame to read as 'positive' sparkles.

shots.focal_element: Triumphant character under the orb, centred in the zigzag starburst
shots.typography: Corner wordmark only: lowercase bold geometric sans, same top-right bug
shots.what_happens: Four-frame variant of the starburst pose: the zigzag bands and plus badges sit in slightly different positions and the character's scale shifts a little, giving a jittery, boiling energy as the VO says 'the easiest' (w17-w18).
shots.build_rebuild: Repeat the starburst frame with the zigzag polygons and plus badges nudged and the character slightly rescaled, swapping drawings every 2 frames for a hand-made boil effect.

shots.focal_element: Triumphant character with orb raised, centred in the starburst, boots dominating the foreground
shots.typography: Corner wordmark only: lowercase bold geometric sans, same top-right bug
shots.what_happens: The starburst pose holds for about 0.7 s while the zigzag rays and plus badges keep shifting between drawings; the character's cape and boots spread slightly wider. Speech continues with 'easiest way' (w18-w19).
shots.build_rebuild: Hold the low-angle triumphant character over the radial zigzag background for about 0.7 s, cycling 2-3 slightly offset drawings of the rays and badges to keep the frame alive.
